name: Nopan Shojo ~Datte, Kimochi Iin da mon♥~
original_name: ノーパン処女～だって、気持ちイイんだもん♥～
source:
"Come to the reading alone if you want to keep your secret."
So said the ominous letter left for Ayaka Aragaki.

"But I don't have any secrets," she thought to herself......

She decided to face her would-be blackmailer.
The person waiting in the library was a lone boy.
In her head she rehearsed how he'd picked the wrong victim.
She was an outstanding role mode. Rule abiding. Well-mannered. Everyone knew that.

"Well well Ms. Ayaka," said the boy. "I never would have pegged you for a public perv."

How did he know? It was impossible that he knew.
But even if he was bluffing she was too shocked to defend the accusation.
It was true, she was an exhibition fetishist. If anyone else found out...
There was no choice but to do exactly what he says.

translation:
“如果你想保守秘密，就一个人来读书吧。”
写给新垣绫香的这封不祥的信是这么说的。

“但我没有什么秘密。”她心里想……

她决定面对潜在的勒索者。
在图书馆等待的人是一个孤独的男孩。
她在脑海中预演了他如何选择了错误的受害者。
她是一个杰出的角色模式。遵守规则。有礼貌。每个人都知道这一点。

“好吧，绫香女士，”男孩说。“我绝不会认为你是公共变态。”

他怎么知道的？他不可能知道。
但即使他是在虚张声势，她也太震惊了，无法为这一指控辩护。
确实，她是个展览迷恋者。如果有其他人发现的话…
没办法，只能按照他说的去做。
